package.name: open_amr_fleet_mock
package.description: Message-level mock of the OpenAMR fleet and its two arm stations, for developing and stress-testing the WMS without Isaac Sim: N robots publish RobotState at 5 Hz, bid travel times over the real lane graph and pick winners with the swarm agent's own rule (open_amr_swarm.auction), claim / release / finish tasks, transfer boxes, drain and charge batteries (open_amr_swarm.energy); stations use open_amr_swarm.station. Failures from a scenario file or a parameter service. Runs faster than real time on /clock, seeded and deterministic.
